_meta.owner: launch-dedup-gc (PR #609 follow-up — operational hygiene for the board-Launch duplicate-work guard)
_meta.tweak_via: edit this file + commit; the GC job reads it on the next tick (no service reload needed)
_meta.rationale: Retention/GC policy for launch_dedup_guard's byproducts. claim_window_hours mirrors the guard's own 24h read window — a .deduped/ hold is only re-surfaced once its justifying deliverable claim has aged out of what the drain would still act on. claims_retention_days (7d) sits well beyond that read window so rotation never drops a claim the guard would still read. claims_min_retained_lines is the floor kept regardless of age. All three are config-tunable (intended to become Pulse-Check self-optimizing); a missing/invalid field falls back to the conservative default for that field.
